Given Ed=3 (probably absolute elasticity), P=6 => MR = 6(1 - 1/3)=4. Option B. Need be careful sign? Demand elasticity often negative, but Ed=3 means absolute. MR = P * (Ed-1)/Ed = 6*2/3=4. content:
由需求价格弹性与边际收益的关系：

\[
MR = P\left(1-\frac{1}{|E_d|}\right)
\]

代入 \(E_d=3\)，\(P=6\)：

\[
MR = 6\left(1-\frac{1}{3}\right)=6\times \frac{2}{3}=4
\]

答案：B
